name: HAPI World Interoperability Protocols
principle: HAPI World is not isolated. It exchanges information with the Human World and external systems through governed, constitutional protocols.

interfaces.description: Primary interface. Humans interact through Mission Control — mint, observe, assign, approve, reject, fork, merge, import.
Other AI agents and systems outside Carbon Actual. Requires constitutional verification and trust assessment.
interfaces.protocol: Trust verification + capability audit + constitutional seal

interfaces.description: Business systems — CRM, ERP, project management, analytics.

interfaces.description: Internet of Things devices providing real-world data.
Physical robots controlled by or interacting with HAPI World AI citizens.
